post.subhook: Plus Apple Intelligence in China and an AI-run mouse surgery

stories.headline: Tampered Claude Code extension live on Cursor for about 12 hours
stories.detail: Up to 5,000 users may have installed it, risking data theft or remote access. Cursor took its marketplace offline to investigate.

stories.headline: Apple Intelligence launches in China, powered by Qwen
stories.detail: A beta arrives Nov. 4, with the full rollout in iOS 27.3 in December. Qwen powers the models in Siri.

stories.headline: Claude model picks a gene therapy, operates on a mouse brain
stories.detail: The agent chose and delivered a treatment with no human decision-making, and refused to continue after a calibration error.

stories.headline: Tech stocks sell off on doubts about AI payback
stories.detail: Nearly $1tn was reportedly wiped from US markets, which may pressure AI companies' funding and capital spending plans.

stories.headline: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Anthropic back AI opt-out standard
stories.detail: Publishers can set AI training preferences across several AI companies at once instead of one by one.

stories.headline: OpenAI expands ChatGPT violence-prevention safeguards
stories.detail: Adds earlier interventions, new protections for teens and a commitment to public safety reporting.

stories.headline: OpenAI reportedly secures about $11B of a $30B target
stories.detail: A smaller-than-planned round at a lower valuation, read as a sign of investor pullback from AI spending.

stories.headline: Reddit says Google AI Mode is cutting web referrals
stories.detail: Reddit reports losing over one million Google referrals per week in October.

stories.headline: Google's satellite TPUs run Gemma 4 in orbit
stories.detail: The on-board model produced its first response from space, a first demonstration of running AI on chips in orbit.

post.caption:
A tampered Claude Code extension sat on Cursor's marketplace for about 12 hours today. Here's what changed in AI.

1. Tampered Claude Code extension reached up to 5,000 Cursor users; Cursor took its marketplace offline to investigate (Ars Technica)
2. Apple Intelligence launches in China with Qwen powering Siri's models: beta Nov. 4, full iOS 27.3 in December (The Verge)
3. A Claude model chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making, then refused to continue after a calibration error (The Decoder)
4. Tech stocks sold off over doubts AI spending pays back quickly, with nearly $1tn reportedly wiped from US markets (The Guardian)
5. OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic back a shared standard for publishers to opt out of AI training (OpenAI)
6. OpenAI expands ChatGPT violence-prevention safeguards and teen protections, and commits to public safety reporting (OpenAI)
7. OpenAI reportedly secures about $11B toward a round targeted at $30B (Techmeme)
8. Reddit says Google AI Mode and AI Overviews cost it over one million referrals per week in October (The Decoder)
9. Google's satellite TPUs booted and Gemma 4 produced its first response from orbit (The Verge)

If you installed extensions from Cursor's marketplace recently, check what you're running. 🔒

clusters.headline: A tampered Claude Code extension on Cursor's marketplace was live for about 12 hours, reaching up to 5,000 users
clusters.why_it_matters: Developers who installed the tampered extension could have had data stolen or remote access set up, and Cursor took its marketplace offline while it investigated.

clusters.headline: Apple Intelligence launches in China with Qwen, with a beta on Nov. 4 and full iOS 27.3 in December
clusters.why_it_matters: Apple's AI features become available to Chinese users, with Qwen powering the models in Siri.

clusters.headline: A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making
clusters.why_it_matters: It shows an AI agent selecting and delivering a treatment to a living animal, and refusing to continue after a calibration error.

clusters.headline: Tech stocks sell off sharply over doubts that AI spending will pay back quickly
clusters.why_it_matters: Nearly $1tn was reportedly wiped from US markets, which may pressure AI companies' funding and capital spending plans.

clusters.headline: OpenAI and Google, Microsoft and Anthropic back a shared standard for publishers to opt out of AI scraping
clusters.why_it_matters: Publishers can apply AI training preferences across several AI companies at once instead of setting them one by one.

clusters.headline: OpenAI expands violence-prevention safeguards for ChatGPT and commits to public safety reporting
clusters.why_it_matters: It adds earlier interventions and new protections for teens in ChatGPT.

clusters.headline: OpenAI reportedly secures about $11B toward a round that was targeted at $30B
clusters.why_it_matters: A smaller-than-planned round at a lower valuation signals investor pullback from AI spending.

clusters.headline: Reddit says Google AI Mode and AI Overviews are driving away search referrals to the open web
clusters.why_it_matters: Reddit reports losing over one million Google referrals per week in October, a sign that AI answers reduce traffic to content sites.
